qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the support frame on body in the gas tank with attachment section?
What torque value should be used when installing the gas density sensor on non-return cock of gas tank?
Which component in the fuel system has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The support frame on body at 45 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What screw type is used for both the support frame on body and gas density sensor on non-return cock?
Which fuel system components use the 316g screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: The holder of filler connection on body

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the support frame on body and the gas density sensor?
Which component has the lowest torque specification in section 13 83?
qa_pairs.answer: The holder for filler connections on body at 3 Nm
